The folders of a run, derived from its configuration

Source: R/glow_layout.R
glow_layout.Rd

Turns a resolved configuration into the folders its steps read and write. The layout has two levels. The assets that depend on the genotypes alone (the GDS files, the annotated GDS files and the principal components) belong to the dataset and sit under data/. Everything that depends on the outcome, the covariates or an analysis setting sits under the analysis.

glow_layout(
  cfg,
  match = cfg$shared$favor_match_method,
  region_types = cfg$snv_set$region_type
)

Arguments

cfg

A glow_config object, as read_glow_config() returns it. It has to hold the top-level settings output_root, dataset and analysis.

match

Character. The name of the level under data/gds_favor/, which is the method that matched the variants to the annotation database. Default: the setting shared.favor_match_method.

region_types

Character vector. The region types that get a folder under snv_set/. Default: the setting snv_set.region_type.

Value

A list of absolute paths: output_root, dataset_dir, analysis_dir, the list data (dir, gds, gds_favor, gds_favor_gds, gds_favor_csv, pcs) and the list steps (data_prep, training, training_b, training_pi, single_variant, snv_set_dir, and snv_set, a character vector named by region type). The elements dataset and analysis repeat the two names.

Details

<output_root>/<dataset>/
  data/gds/                       the converted GDS files
  data/gds_favor/<match>/gds/     the annotated GDS files
  data/gds_favor/<match>/csv/     the annotation tables
  data/pcs/                       the principal components
  <analysis>/data_prep/           the phenotype bundle
  <analysis>/training/b/          the B training table and model
  <analysis>/training/pi/         the PI case tables and models
  <analysis>/single_variant/      the single-variant scan
  <analysis>/snv_set/<region_type>/   one folder per region type

A relative output_root is read from the root the configuration was loaded with (the attribute glow_root). The function builds paths and nothing else: it creates no folder and reads no file. Computational complexity: constant.

Assumptions: dataset and analysis are single names without a path separator, which read_glow_config() checks.

See also

read_glow_config(), glow_absolute_paths()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
cfg <- read_glow_config("cohort0203.yml", base = "base-config/base_config.yml",
                        registry = "base-config/settings-registry.yml")
lay <- glow_layout(cfg)
lay$steps$snv_set[["gene"]]
} # }
